title: 第二章 末世倒计时-《末世入侵：我在副本里面当NPC》
content:
第(1/3)页

    好在爻雪并没有颓废多长时间。

    末世又怎样，她还有金手指呢，虽然看上去有点弱，但有总比没有好，而且她还提前得知了末世的消息，也就是说，她有更多的时间去准备所需要的东西。

    这样想着，她瞬间变得有动力起来。

    对，她不能放弃自己，就算是末世她也一定要好好的活下去。

    首先，就是收集物资了，除了衣食住行等一系列的末世小说主角必囤的物资之外，她还需要准备大量的建筑材料，她不清楚系统需要多少，但肯定是越多越好，毕竟选项里面可是还有一个升级呢。

    想要购买物资，资金肯定是少不了的，原主的父母去世，给原主留下了大量的财产，将这些财产全部卖掉之后，应该就足够她接下来购买物资了，至于需要绑定的土地，这方面她并不是很懂，所以还需要去摆脱专业人士才行。

    这样想着，爻雪拿出手机，解锁，点开联系人，根据脑海中的记忆，她播出了一个电话号码。

    电话震动了两声之后，那边传来了被接起的声音。

    “你好，我需要……”

    爻雪简单说了一下自己的诉求之后，电话另一边的那个人先是震惊，再再三确认过她的要求之后，这种震惊又逐渐转变成了狂喜。

    “您放心吧爻小姐，我们一定会尽力满足您的要求的。”
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Fortunately, Yaoxue did not remain depressed for long.

So what if it’s the end of the world? She still has a golden finger. Although it looks a bit weak, it’s better than nothing. Moreover, she also learned about the end of the world in advance, which means she has more time to prepare what she needs.

Thinking like this, she instantly became motivated.

Yes, she can't give up on herself, even if it's the end of the world, she must live well.

First of all, it is to collect supplies. In addition to a series of supplies that the protagonist of apocalyptic novels must stock up on, such as food, clothing, housing, and transportation, she also needs to prepare a large amount of building materials. She is not sure how much the system requires, but the more the better. After all, there is an upgrade in the option.

If you want to buy supplies, funds are definitely indispensable. The original owner's parents passed away and left a large amount of property to the original owner. After selling all these properties, it should be enough for her to purchase supplies. As for the land that needs to be bound, she doesn't know much about this, so she still needs to get rid of professionals.

Thinking like this, Yaoxue took out her phone, unlocked it, clicked on the contact, and based on the memory in her mind, she broadcast a phone number.

After the phone vibrated twice, there was a sound of being picked up.

"Hello, I need..."

After Yaoxue briefly stated her request, the person on the other side of the phone was shocked at first. After confirming her request again and again, the shock gradually turned into ecstasy.

"Don't worry, Miss Yao, we will do our best to meet your requirements."
